It opens with the two most urgent actions: submit to Daily Papers 'today' rather than on launch day, and fix duration=300. Nothing in it spans weeks, such as community building or content series. It loses a point on compression. The checklist has about 15 items across three subsections, with no time slots or must-do vs nice-to-have split inside section 3.
